description.value: Sizzling Tandoor has anchored Victoria's Indian dining scene for over 15 years, offering tandoor-cooked breads, regionally inspired curries, and a full cocktail and wine program. The Uptown location now operates under the KINU by Sizzling Tandoor brand, a contemporary tapas concept blending Indian flavours with globally inspired dishes in the Uptown shopping district. A second Downtown location on Johnson Street continues the original Sizzling Tandoor brand.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms two active Victoria locations: KINU by Sizzling Tandoor at #123 3600 Uptown Blvd (V8Z 0B9, phone 778-265-7775) and Sizzling Tandoor Downtown at 637 Johnson Street (V8W 1M7, phone 250-388-5450). The OSM node's coordinates (48.439408, -123.5061807) place it in the Uptown/Saanich area, but the OSM street address 'Phipps Road, unit 129' matches neither confirmed website location, and the unit number (129 vs. #123) also conflicts. The menu page's /cart functionality provides positive evidence of online ordering/takeout, and pervasive [V] and [GF] menu tags confirm vegetarian and gluten-free options.
concerns: OSM address 'Phipps Road, unit 129' matches neither confirmed website location (Uptown: #123 3600 Uptown Blvd V8Z 0B9; Downtown: 637 Johnson Street V8W 1M7). Address needs manual verification.
OSM unit number '129' conflicts with the website's Uptown unit '#123'.
The Uptown location has rebranded as 'KINU by Sizzling Tandoor'; the OSM name 'Sizzling Tandoor' may correspond specifically to the Downtown (637 Johnson Street) location instead.
OSM record carries no phone number; Uptown phone (778)-265-7775 and Downtown phone (250)-388-5450 were taken from the website.
Website footer displays placeholder phone number (512) 555-0110, a US/Texas area code, indicating a website template element was not replaced with real contact data.

enrichment_extras.notes: This business has two distinct Victoria locations. The OSM node's coordinates suggest it represents the Uptown location (KINU by Sizzling Tandoor, #123 3600 Uptown Blvd), but the address tags in OSM do not support this. A separate OSM record may or may not exist for the Downtown (637 Johnson Street) location; check for duplicates.
